notes: PDF generated by Mac OS X 10.6.6 Quartz PDFContext from Microsoft Word. Body text uses a custom font encoding that renders garbled via standard text extraction (pdftotext, pdfplumber, markitdown). OCR via tesseract at 300 DPI produced clean text. Embedded images are small (295x105px kernel diagrams and 453x246px chart). Full-page PNGs at 300 DPI preserved in assets/ as they contain both text and inline figures. The Figure 1 chart (NinjaTrader screenshot comparing SMA, EMA, HMA, ALMA) is on page 3.
